question: 부서별 위치를 알려줘

question: 프로젝트 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects

question: 부서 수를 알려줘

question: 2024년에 시작한 프로젝트를 조회해줘

question: 급여가 100000 이상인 직원의 이름과 급여를 알려줘

question: 직원을 이름 순으로 정렬해줘
sql: SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY name ASC

question: 가장 최근에 입사한 직원을 알려줘
sql: SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY hire_date DESC LIMIT 1

question: 예산이 1000000 이상인 부서를 찾아줘
sql: SELECT * FROM departments WHERE budget >= 1000000

question: 프로젝트를 시작일 순으로 정렬해줘
sql: SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY start_date ASC

question: 배정 시간이 가장 많은 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT employee_id, SUM(hours) as total_hours FROM assignments GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY total_hours DESC LIMIT 1

question: Engineering 부서 직원 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering'

question: 직원별 급여 등급을 매겨줘 (50000 이상 High, 이하 Low)
sql: SELECT name, CASE WHEN salary >= 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END as grade FROM employees

question: 이름과 급여를 조회하되 급여가 NULL인 건 제외해줘
sql: SELECT name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary IS NOT NULL

question: 부서 이름을 중복 없이 조회해줘
sql: SELECT DISTINCT department FROM employees

question: 프로젝트가 active이거나 pending인 것을 조회해줘
sql: SELECT * FROM projects WHERE status IN ('active', 'pending')

question: 직원 ID가 1, 2, 3인 직원을 조회해줘
sql: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3)

question: 급여를 10% 인상한 결과를 보여줘
sql: SELECT name, salary, salary * 1.1 as new_salary FROM employees

question: 부서별 평균 급여를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, AVG(salary) as avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 부서별 직원 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 직원과 그 직원이 속한 부서의 예산을 함께 조회해줘
sql: SELECT e.name, d.budget FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department = d.name

question: 프로젝트와 해당 부서 이름을 함께 조회해줘
sql: SELECT p.name, d.name as dept_name FROM projects p JOIN departments d ON p.department_id = d.id

question: 부서별 평균 급여가 50000 이상인 부서를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, AVG(salary) as avg_sal FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING AVG(salary) >= 50000

question: 직원과 배정된 프로젝트를 함께 조회해줘
sql: SELECT e.name, p.name as project FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id

question: 프로젝트별 배정된 직원 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(a.employee_id) as cnt FROM projects p JOIN assignments a ON p.id = a.project_id GROUP BY p.name

question: 부서별 최고 급여를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, MAX(salary) as max_sal FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 직원별 총 배정 시간을 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.name, SUM(a.hours) as total FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id GROUP BY e.name

question: 3개 이상의 프로젝트에 배정된 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT e.name, COUNT(a.project_id) as proj_cnt FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id GROUP BY e.name HAVING COUNT(a.project_id) >= 3

question: 부서별 급여 합계가 큰 순으로 정렬해줘
sql: SELECT department, SUM(salary) as total FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY total DESC

question: 각 프로젝트의 총 작업 시간을 알려줘
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(a.hours) as total_hours FROM projects p JOIN assignments a ON p.id = a.project_id GROUP BY p.name

question: 매니저가 있는 직원과 매니저 이름을 함께 조회해줘
sql: SELECT e.name as employee, m.name as manager FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id

question: 부서와 그 부서의 프로젝트 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(p.id) as proj_cnt FROM departments d LEFT JOIN projects p ON d.id = p.department_id GROUP BY d.name

question: 활성 프로젝트에 배정된 직원 이름을 알려줘
sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.name FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'active'

question: 급여가 부서 평균보다 높은 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT e.name, e.salary, e.department FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT department, AVG(salary) as avg_sal FROM employees GROUP BY department) d ON e.department = d.department WHERE e.salary > d.avg_sal

question: 직원이 5명 이상인 부서만 조회해줘
sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

question: 배정되지 않은 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE a.employee_id IS NULL

question: 부서별 급여 중앙값 대신 평균과 최소, 최대를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, AVG(salary) as avg_sal, MIN(salary) as min_sal, MAX(salary) as max_sal FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 프로젝트가 없는 부서를 찾아줘
sql: SELECT d.name FROM departments d LEFT JOIN projects p ON d.id = p.department_id WHERE p.id IS NULL

question: 각 역할별 평균 배정 시간을 알려줘
sql: SELECT role, AVG(hours) as avg_hours FROM assignments GROUP BY role

question: 서울 부서의 직원 이름과 급여를 조회해줘
sql: SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department = d.name WHERE d.location = 'Seoul'

question: 프로젝트별 lead 역할 직원을 조회해줘
sql: SELECT p.name, e.name as lead FROM projects p JOIN assignments a ON p.id = a.project_id JOIN employees e ON a.employee_id = e.id WHERE a.role = 'lead'

question: 부서별 2023년 이후 입사자 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM employees WHERE hire_date >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY department

question: 직원 수가 가장 많은 부서 Top 3를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3

question: 프로젝트 기간(일수)을 계산해줘
sql: SELECT name, JULIANDAY(end_date) - JULIANDAY(start_date) as duration_days FROM projects

question: 완료된 프로젝트의 부서별 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(p.id) as completed FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.id = p.department_id WHERE p.status = 'completed' GROUP BY d.name

question: 급여 상위 10%에 해당하는 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary >= (SELECT salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) / 10 FROM employees))

question: 부서별 입사일이 가장 오래된 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT department, name, hire_date FROM employees e WHERE hire_date = (SELECT MIN(hire_date) FROM employees WHERE department = e.department)

question: 전체 직원의 급여 표준편차와 평균을 알려줘
sql: SELECT AVG(salary) as avg_sal, AVG(salary * salary) - AVG(salary) * AVG(salary) as variance FROM employees

question: 각 위치별 부서 수와 총 예산을 알려줘
sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) as dept_cnt, SUM(budget) as total_budget FROM departments GROUP BY location

question: 프로젝트에 가장 많은 시간을 투입한 직원 Top 5를 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.name, SUM(a.hours) as total FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: 같은 매니저를 가진 직원들을 그룹으로 보여줘
sql: SELECT manager_id, GROUP_CONCAT(name) as team_members FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY manager_id

question: 부서별 급여 범위(최대-최소)를 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, MAX(salary) - MIN(salary) as salary_range FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 연도별 입사자 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT SUBSTR(hire_date, 1, 4) as year, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM employees GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: 활성 프로젝트가 2개 이상인 부서를 알려줘
sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(p.id) as active_cnt FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.id = p.department_id WHERE p.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.name HAVING COUNT(p.id) >= 2

question: 각 직원의 프로젝트 참여 수와 평균 시간을 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.name, COUNT(a.project_id) as proj_cnt, AVG(a.hours) as avg_hours FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id GROUP BY e.name

question: 부서 예산 대비 급여 총액 비율을 알려줘
sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(e.salary) as total_sal, d.budget, ROUND(SUM(e.salary) * 100.0 / d.budget, 1) as ratio FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.name = e.department GROUP BY d.name

question: lead 역할 직원의 평균 급여를 알려줘
sql: SELECT AVG(e.salary) as avg_lead_salary FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE a.role = 'lead'

question: 부서별 직원 목록을 한 줄로 보여줘
sql: SELECT department, GROUP_CONCAT(name, ', ') as members FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 부서 평균보다 급여가 높은 직원의 이름, 급여, 부서 평균을 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.name, e.salary, d.avg_sal FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT department, AVG(salary) as avg_sal FROM employees GROUP BY department) d ON e.department = d.department WHERE e.salary > d.avg_sal

question: 모든 프로젝트에 참여한 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT p.id FROM projects p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a WHERE a.employee_id = e.id AND a.project_id = p.id))

question: 직원별 급여 순위를 매겨줘
sql: SELECT name, salary, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.salary > e1.salary) + 1 as rank FROM employees e1 ORDER BY salary DESC

question: 부서별 급여 1위 직원을 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.department, e.name, e.salary FROM employees e WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees WHERE department = e.department)

question: 자신의 매니저보다 급여가 높은 직원을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT e.name as employee, e.salary as emp_sal, m.name as manager, m.salary as mgr_sal FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id WHERE e.salary > m.salary

question: 3개 이상의 부서에서 프로젝트가 있고 예산이 500000 이상인 위치를 찾아줘
sql: SELECT d.location, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as dept_cnt FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.id = p.department_id WHERE d.budget >= 500000 GROUP BY d.location HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) >= 3

question: 프로젝트에 참여하지 않는 직원 중 급여 상위 5명을 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM employees e WHERE e.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT employee_id FROM assignments) ORDER BY e.salary DESC LIMIT 5

question: 부서별 급여 분포를 사분위로 나눠줘
sql: SELECT department, MIN(salary) as min, AVG(salary) as avg, MAX(salary) as max, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 각 직원이 참여한 프로젝트 중 가장 긴 프로젝트의 기간을 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.name, MAX(JULIANDAY(p.end_date) - JULIANDAY(p.start_date)) as max_duration FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id GROUP BY e.name

question: 전체 예산 대비 각 부서 예산 비율을 알려줘
sql: SELECT name, budget, ROUND(budget * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(budget) FROM departments), 2) as pct FROM departments ORDER BY pct DESC

question: 동일 부서 내에서 급여 차이가 가장 큰 쌍을 찾아줘
sql: SELECT e1.name, e2.name, e1.department, ABS(e1.salary - e2.salary) as diff FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.department = e2.department AND e1.id < e2.id ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2023년에 시작하여 아직 완료되지 않은 프로젝트와 배정 인원을 알려줘
sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(a.employee_id) as assigned FROM projects p LEFT JOIN assignments a ON p.id = a.project_id WHERE p.start_date >= '2023-01-01' AND p.status != 'completed' GROUP BY p.name

question: 매니저 체인을 한 단계만 따라가서 직원-매니저-매니저의매니저를 보여줘
sql: SELECT e.name as employee, m1.name as manager, m2.name as skip_manager FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m1 ON e.manager_id = m1.id LEFT JOIN employees m2 ON m1.manager_id = m2.id WHERE e.manager_id IS NOT NULL

question: 부서별로 급여가 가장 높은 직원과 가장 낮은 직원의 이름을 알려줘
sql: SELECT department, (SELECT name FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.department = e1.department ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1) as highest, (SELECT name FROM employees e3 WHERE e3.department = e1.department ORDER BY salary ASC LIMIT 1) as lowest FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM employees) e1

question: 각 프로젝트의 참여 직원 수, 총 시간, 평균 급여를 종합 보고서로 만들어줘
sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.employee_id) as members, SUM(a.hours) as total_hours, AVG(e.salary) as avg_sal FROM projects p JOIN assignments a ON p.id = a.project_id JOIN employees e ON a.employee_id = e.id GROUP BY p.name

question: 급여 상위 20%와 하위 20% 직원의 평균 프로젝트 참여 수를 비교해줘
sql: SELECT 'Top 20%' as grp, AVG(proj_cnt) as avg_projects FROM (SELECT e.id, COUNT(a.project_id) as proj_cnt FROM employees e LEFT JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE e.salary >= (SELECT salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) * 20 / 100 FROM employees)) GROUP BY e.id) UNION ALL SELECT 'Bottom 20%', AVG(proj_cnt) FROM (SELECT e.id, COUNT(a.project_id) as proj_cnt FROM employees e LEFT JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE e.salary <= (SELECT salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) * 20 / 100 FROM employees)) GROUP BY e.id)

question: 예산 효율성(프로젝트 수 / 예산)이 가장 높은 부서 Top 3를 알려줘
sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(p.id) as proj_cnt, d.budget, ROUND(COUNT(p.id) * 1.0 / d.budget * 1000000, 2) as efficiency FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.id = p.department_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY efficiency DESC LIMIT 3

question: 직원별 급여 백분위를 계산해줘
sql: SELECT name, salary, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.salary <= e1.salary) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees), 1) as percentile FROM employees e1 ORDER BY salary

question: 부서 간 인력 이동이 가능하다면, 급여 표준편차를 최소화하는 배치를 시뮬레이션해줘 (현재 통계만)
sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) as cnt, AVG(salary) as avg_sal, AVG(salary * salary) - AVG(salary) * AVG(salary) as variance, (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) as company_avg FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: 크로스 프로젝트 협업이 많은 직원 (2개 이상 프로젝트에 동시 참여)과 그들의 부서를 알려줘
sql: SELECT e.name, e.department, COUNT(DISTINCT a.project_id) as proj_cnt FROM employees e JOIN assignments a ON e.id = a.employee_id GROUP BY e.name, e.department HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.project_id) >= 2 ORDER BY proj_cnt DESC
